title: A New Start with Christ
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he welcomes you to The River Church's YouTube channel and shares an encouraging message of hope and faith. In this sermon, Pastor Chris sets the stage for the powerful messages and testimonies of miracles and healing that you'll find on this channel, and he invites you to experience God's presence and life-changing power for yourself. Whether you're looking for a fresh start or seeking to deepen your faith, this sermon is a great place to begin.
